claim: Foot Locker U.K. Ltd (02568406) and Freedom Sportsline Ltd (01779106) have not filed their accounts to 31 Dec 2025. Companies House now shows them due by 31 Dec 2026; a 23 Jan 2026 archived page showed 30 Sep 2026, which points to a roughly 3-month extension. No AA01 has been filed, so the year-end stays 31 Dec and has not moved to DKS's fiscal calendar. The extension looks routine: the group has filed in December every year since 2022.
data_point: Accounts due 30 Sep 2026 (Wayback, 23 Jan 2026) -> 31 Dec 2026 (live, 7 Oct 2026). No AA or AA01 filed. AA filing dates: FY2021 19 Dec 2022 (after a GAZ1 on 29 Nov 2022), FY2022 17 Dec 2023, FY2023 19 Dec 2024, FY2024 01 Dec 2025. Earlier GAZ1s: 08 Mar 2022 and 29 Nov 2022, both discontinued (DISS40).

original_quote: Next accounts made up to 31 December 2025 due by 30 September 2026 [archived 23 Jan 2026] / Next accounts made up to 31 December 2025 due by 31 December 2026 [live 7 Oct 2026]
verifier_note: Re-fetched the live overview pages for both entities: both show 'due by 31 December 2026', and there are no AA or AA01 filings. Re-fetched the 23 Jan 2026 Wayback snapshot of 01779106: it shows 'due by 30 September 2026'. Pages 1-5 of the filing history confirm the December filing pattern. That pattern is FOUR years running (Dec 2022-Dec 2025), not three as the scraper said, and three of those filings drew no strike-off notice, so extensions were most likely granted each year. Downgraded to C because the extension is routine group behaviour, not a DKS-era signal. The 31 Dec 2026 due date was already in B_w1 registry-uk-ie. The new facts are the extension and the absence of an ARD change. That the extension was granted under s.442 is inference, since applications are not public.

claim: Neither Irish FL company has filed its 2026 annual return with CY2025 financial statements. Foot Locker Retail Ireland Ltd (391370) has an ARD of 23 Sep 2026 and FL Finance (Europe) Ltd (391464), the Irish holdco, 27 Sep 2026, so with the 56-day online window they are due around 18 and 22 Nov 2026. FL Finance (Europe) filed its FY2024 return and financial statements late: received 04 Dec 2025, 68 days after its 27 Sep 2025 ARD. Its post-deal B10 effective 07 Oct 2025 was received 25 Nov 2025, 49 days later against the 14-day limit. Both companies are 'Normal' status, with no strike-off or merger filings.

B10 lags: 391464 07/10/2025 -> 25/11/2025 (49 days) and 01/10/2026 -> 05/10/2026 (4 days); 391370 11/03/2026 -> 09/04/2026 (29 days) and 23/07/2026 -> 19/08/2026 (27 days).

SoloCheck fetched live: '391464 FINANCIAL STATEMENT 21 27/09/2025 04/12/2025' and 'B10 ... 07/10/2025 25/11/2025' match. CORRECTION: the scraper attributed all three late B10s to FL Finance (Europe). The 29-day and 27-day lags are Foot Locker Retail Ireland's (391370); only the 49-day lag is FL Finance (Europe)'s. The FY2022/FY2023 lags (30/34/74 days) come from older CRO datasets and were not re-verified. The ~18/22 Nov deadline uses CRO's 56-day online filing window for annual returns; the penalty and loss-of-audit-exemption consequences are the scraper's reading of CRO rules and were not checked. The signal is weak and administrative. Its value is the watch date: the CY2025 FS of the Irish holdco, which holds stakes in and loans to European subsidiaries, should appear in the CRO index by about 22 Nov 2026. The B10 index rows themselves are already in B_w1 item 7; the late-filing and due-date facts are new.

claim: The FL UK FY2024 group accounts, signed 24 Nov 2025 after the DKS close, still set out the 'UK Lacing Up For Our Future' growth programme, including the target 'Increase store penetration'. The s172(a) paragraph is copied word for word from the FY2023 accounts, and s172(f) still calls the group 'a wholly owned subsidiary of the Foot Locker Inc. group'. The strategy text was not rewritten for DKS ownership, so it is weak evidence of UK intent either way. It does give a baseline to compare against the CY2025 accounts, which are due by 31 Dec 2026.
data_point: FY2024 Strategic report p.2 (s172(a)) is identical to FY2023 p.2, apart from the year in the s172(d) LEED sentence. The p.1 risk section still points to 'Foot Lockers Inc. consolidated financial statements (under Item 1A "Risk Factors")'. Going concern (p.8): 'In Europe, the group is managed on a Europe-wide basis with management activities centralised in the Netherlands'.
